title: Wholesome Thai Chicken Liver Khao Soi
description: A rich, savory, and slightly spicy Thai-inspired Khao Soi variation featuring chicken liver, perfect for a weeknight dinner or special occasion.

ingredients.name: Infused oil
ingredients.notes: Use any flavorful oil, such as sesame or peanut oil.

instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine turmeric, ginger, garlic, and 2 tablespoons of infused oil. Blend until smooth. Heat 1 tablespoon of infused oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the blended mixture and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add the chicken liver to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until browned and cooked through, about 5 minutes.
Add the coconut milk, fish sauce, palm sugar, and fermented bean paste to the skillet. Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, until the sauce has thickened, about 5 minutes.
Add the cooked noodles to the skillet and toss everything together to coat the noodles in the sauce.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste. Garnish with cilantro and serve hot.
